purpose: Teach: 書面/代理人/不調/派閥/期末/行き先/続行/後押し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約、本気で、絶対、書面、絶対、で、絶対、交わせ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Get that contract in writing. I'm serious. Non-negotiable.
lines.style: Sharp, direct attack. Each sentence clipped and final. No room for interpretation. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who has seen things go wrong before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、代理人、絶対、契約、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Our agent is handling the contract progression. I appreciate your confidence.
lines.style: Measured and formal. Respectful without being deferential. Clear enunciation on key terms. Slight pause between thoughts, like he's checking his list as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機械の、本気で、絶対、不調、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the equipment status. Now. I want confirmation.
lines.style: Firm, no softening. The first two words hit hard. Pause after 'Now' — deliberate. Not angry, but the urgency is unmistakable. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、本気で、絶対、派閥、絶対、なきよう、絶対、運営しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm ensuring there are no internal divisions in how we operate. Thank you for this opportunity.
lines.style: Professional, composed. Speaking with careful precision. Slight formality that shows respect for the weight of the responsibility. Steady, reliable rhythm throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 期末、本気で、絶対、決算、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Move forward on the year-end settlement. Don't stall.
lines.style: Direct command. Short, declarative sentences. Slight impatience underneath — not angry, but time-conscious. The intonation suggests this has been delayed before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。配送、本気で、絶対、行き先、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm verifying all delivery destinations carefully. Thank you for the trust.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Speaking like someone who has this under control. Slightly slower pace to convey thorough attention to detail. Reassuring without being overly warm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクト、本気で、絶対、続行、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep the project running. Full commitment.
lines.style: Decisive and final. Short, powerful statements. The kind of instruction that ends discussion. Settled tone — this is non-negotiable. Clear authority without aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規事業、本気で、絶対、後押し、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're pushing the new initiative forward aggressively. I appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Confident and forward-looking. Slightly energized tone — there's momentum here. Professional but not stiff. A closing statement that suggests readiness for the next phase.
